statements.statement: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope (R55)
These symptoms are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring
The service is ordered to correlate patient-reported palpitations and presyncopal events with underlying arrhythmias
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
The service is not reimbursable as a standalone item when performed in conjunction with the primary diagnostic evaluation
The service is medically necessary and distinct from the bundled diagnostic evaluation
